narrative:
Technology and premises investment is about EUR 23M a year: core banking and digital channels EUR 9.0M, the Spanish banking platform and BEF integration EUR 5.5M, premises fit-outs in Madrid, Barcelona, Zurich and Miami EUR 4.0M, the data and AI platform EUR 2.5M and cybersecurity EUR 2.0M.

Depreciation was EUR 11.2M in FY2025, up from EUR 7.9M, as the refurbished Andorra head office and new digital capabilities came into use.

signals.title: Efficiency ratio 60.1% vs EU average 55.0%
signals.excerpt: Staff costs +26% to €60.4M with 584 people, 30% more than three years ago.
